wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here: answer one question about a door, a stone or a mark to open a world you can play, or choose a world below.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try each question style, see what each reading points to, and jump straight into that world.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what to do first on each.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Set the pace of a breath, clear a window, or put one thing down and let the room settle.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your stars through a lens, catch comet memos, or turn the sky into a postcard.

worlds.name: the gravity well
worlds.what: Aim a probe past a well, compare two nearly identical paths, or use a moving well to trade speed without firing an engine.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Write a logbook entry from your stars, seal it, or call each star back in order.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Tap your stars to hear echoes, or conduct their voices into a score.

worlds.name: the pulse loom
worlds.what: Weave two beat patterns, or watch how pictures of a clockwise wheel can seem to turn backwards.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Light stars as lanterns in an order you choose, then let them rise.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Water plants grown from your stars, read the greenhouse glass, or regrow the bed.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Turn your stars into a weather map, launch probes, and print a forecast.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Mirror your stars into a moving weave, or overlap two striped screens to reveal bands.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Run a rule across a tape, compare two tapes one cell apart, or rewind a scrambled picture to find what its companion sheet remembers.

worlds.name: the light table
worlds.what: Send specks through slits, or move and turn a third filter to discover how an extra barrier can brighten the screen.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Shove blocks, flip gravity, or set off dominoes to test a prediction.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Set the grit, plant and water, then take a core sample of the roots below.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed words into the kiln, draw out new terms, and let the batch cool.

worlds.name: the cipher cabinet
worlds.what: Decode notes from a shifting house by turning a letter wheel, asking for a one-letter hint, and lifting the shutter.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Name an impossible specimen, compare it with the drawer, or turn it to see another side.

worlds.name: the shadow theatre
worlds.what: Play with paper cutouts, or move the lamp around one carved solid that casts a circle, a square and a triangle.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Turn your sky under a wheel, draw an omen, forge a sigil, and stamp the reading.

finePrint.name: privacy
finePrint.what: Read exactly what stays in your browser, what cookies can count, and how to clear everything.

finePrint.name: terms
finePrint.what: Read the plain bargain: play freely, keep what you make, and expect no warranty.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Miss a page and you still land in the river: the next piece opens here, with every world below.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: Get the same page list in XML, with relative paths that work under any publish path.
